findings.result: ShadowMatch is the only newly opted-in pairSafeProgress caller. New receipt-drain and parent-claim paths are guarded by gameId === shadowmatch. Existing Rocket Builder, Fuel Up, Fire Rescue, Ladder Rescue, Dino Detective and Dino Jigsaw callers retain their prior opt-in paths; the generic per-round award suppression was already shared by those paths.

Uses existing per-child *_little_progress map and spreads root/game records, preserving sibling and unknown valid metadata. Strict result writes require valid read, exact readback and recover the same transaction after uncertain readback. Legacy high-water becomes pairLegacyRewardThrough, avoiding retroactive rewards. Per-level best receipts are positive-only, stable by level/best, validated against score/legacy ceilings, and marked claimed with readback. Pending receipts drain sequentially before play; local, parent or marker failure leaves a visible Retry.

App gives little games the raw celebrate callback; Shadow Match passes receipt.points directly (first perfect fresh level delta is 8, within parent claim cap 12) and uses rewardClaimToken(shadowmatch,id), normalized to reserved dino:shadowmatch namespace. Colour Mixing Lab is non-little and passes rewardDelta*4 through scaledCelebrate; its one actual point remains one. Parent claims and allowlists recognize both game IDs.

Storage keys are player-scoped (amari_little_progress / askia_little_progress); transaction and receipt records remain under the selected child entry. Existing inventory snapshots show no Shadow Match row for either child before this candidate at either origin; this review did not mutate records.

Authored levels use 3/6/8/10/12 species; the final level has mirrored silhouettes and up to six choices. Twelve transparent art assets are referenced: six v1 species plus six v2 additions; silhouette rendering derives from the same source alpha, preserving outline. Existing art provenance is recorded in shadow-art-20261021/art-provenance.json.

A Shadow-only receipt field was initially included in generic pair metadata validation and recovered-transaction access. This could reject or throw on a different game carrying the same previously-unknown field. Fixed by narrowing receipt validation, retrieval and pending-read API to Shadow Match. Regression now covers opaque object metadata through read, write and same-transaction recovery for Rocket Builder, Fuel Up and Dino Jigsaw.

Resolved in committed source aea42f6467e5820b420e20e9d9f71d019da5f5da. A fresh receipt drain before Play used to reset a child-selected lower practice level to the persisted high-water level. It now preserves the selected level clamped to the child minimum and persisted high-water, while refreshing the high-water state and draining pending receipts before play. This is a source/code review finding fixed by this agent; it is not a browser acceptance claim.
